summary: Iteration 23 — Custom Affiliate Codes (POST /api/affiliate/code) end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_affiliate_code_v23.py (11 cases, all pass) covering auth-gate (401), full validation matrix (422 for length <3 / >16 / spaces / special chars, model accepts A-Z 0-9 _ -), 'not a promoter yet' (400), /affiliate/me exposes code_editable=true & code_change_used=false before change, happy-path with FRESH mailinator customer changing the code (SellAuth accepts, response reflects new code + https://pokecoins.cc/?ref=NEWCODE link, affiliate_code_changed_at persisted, injection of customer_id/sellauth_customer_id/email in body IGNORED — caller only ever acts on their own linked customer), second POST returns 400 'You have already personalised your code once' and the code stays as the FIRST custom one (SellAuth NOT hit twice), duplicate collision returns readable 400 with SellAuth 'already in use' message (JSON body preserved, not a Cloudflare page), CodeChangeRequest pydantic model unit test. Regression: /app/backend/tests/test_affiliate_v21.py (20/20) + /app/backend/tests/test_admin_affiliates_v22.py (8/8) still green — admin PUT tier now returns 400 with 'AffiliateTier not found' as expected (formerly 502). Frontend Playwright at desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844: fresh user registered + enrolled via API, then /my-orders → tab-refer opens refer-earn-panel, edit-code-btn visible before change and code-locked-note absent (0), edit-code-btn click opens edit-code-dialog, typing 'AB' shows code-invalid-note and Save disabled, typing 'BAD!CODE' shows note and Save disabled, typing valid unique code enables Save, click Save closes dialog and updates referral-link text to https://pokecoins.cc/?ref=<NEWCODE> without a reload, mobile 390px no horizontal overflow. Toast 'Your code is now …' confirmed in screenshot.

minor.issue: Response body returns stale code_change_used=false immediately after a successful change. Root cause: server.py L1226 calls affiliate_view(detail, tier, shop, user) using the SAME user dict from Depends(get_current_user) — that dict was fetched BEFORE the DB $set of affiliate_code_changed_at (L1220-1221), so the derived flag on L1055 evaluates to False. A subsequent GET /affiliate/me correctly returns code_change_used=true (verified in test_affiliate_code_v23::TestChangeCode). Impact on UX: the frontend passes the POST response straight into setData via onSaved(data) (ReferEarn.jsx L163), so the Edit-my-code button remains visible and code-locked-note stays absent until the page is reloaded or /affiliate/me is refetched. FIX (trivial, 1 line): add `user['affiliate_code_changed_at'] = utc_now()` between L1221 and L1226 so affiliate_view sees the updated value, OR re-read the user doc from Mongo before building the view. Reproduced live: after Save the UI kept edit-code-btn=1 and code-locked-note=0 despite the code and link both updating correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful code save, 'Edit my code' button stays visible and 'personalised' note is absent until a page reload. Downstream of the backend stale-flag bug above — no frontend change needed once backend is fixed. Optional belt-and-braces: after onSaved, call load() to refetch /affiliate/me instead of trusting the POST payload.

The one bug flagged (stale code_change_used in POST /api/affiliate/code response) is a 1-line fix in server.py change_affiliate_code() — main agent should apply it, then re-run the Playwright section (register→enrol→open edit-code-dialog→save valid code→assert edit-code-btn count == 0 AND code-locked-note count == 1 WITHOUT reload). rca_of_the_issue: server.py change_affiliate_code() (L1204-1226): the request handler receives `user` from Depends(get_current_user), executes SellAuth set_code, does `db.users.update_one({...},{'$set':{'affiliate_code_changed_at': utc_now()}})`, but then builds the response body via affiliate_view(detail, tier, shop, user) — the same `user` dict, which was populated BEFORE the update and therefore does NOT contain the newly-set field. affiliate_view() computes `code_change_used = bool((user or {}).get('affiliate_code_changed_at'))` and returns False. Frontend ReferEarn.jsx trusts the response payload (onSaved passes it to setData), so the UI keeps showing the Edit button and hides the locked note until the next /affiliate/me fetch (e.g. page reload). Mitigation: either (a) mutate the local user dict — `user['affiliate_code_changed_at'] = utc_now()` — before affiliate_view is called; or (b) refetch the user from Mongo; or (c) on the frontend, call load() instead of trusting the POST response. (a) is the smallest, most robust change and mirrors what the DB has just been asked to persist.
